{
  "sprint_goal": "Deliver foundational data quality framework enabling automated profiling, configurable rule validation, and real-time alerting integrated with Databricks, Snowflake, and Airflow.",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "T-001",
      "title": "Develop automated profiling pipelines for new data sources",
      "description": "Create Airflow DAGs that trigger Great Expectations profiling on new Databricks/Snowflake datasets, capturing completeness and uniqueness metrics automatically.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 12.0,
      "dependencies": []
    },
    {
      "id": "T-002",
      "title": "Implement YAML-based rule configuration parser",
      "description": "Enable users to define quality validation rules in YAML and integrate parser with Great Expectations configuration, supporting all five quality dimensions.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": []
    },
    {
      "id": "T-003",
      "title": "Integrate real-time alerting via Slack and PagerDuty",
      "description": "Develop alerting module to send grouped and severity-filtered notifications to Slack and PagerDuty for failed quality checks above defined thresholds.",
      "category": "DevOps",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001", "T-002"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-004",
      "title": "Design and implement data quality score dashboard",
      "description": "Create dashboards showing domain-level quality scores across completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency, and uniqueness using Databricks visualizations or BI tool.",
      "category": "Frontend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001", "T-002"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-005",
      "title": "Develop self-healing workflows for common failure patterns",
      "description": "Build Airflow jobs that automatically remediate missing partitions, fill NULLs, or rerun failed validation tasks when detect patterns match predefined rules.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-006",
      "title": "Expose quality metrics in Atlan/DataHub catalogs",
      "description": "Integrate metric push mechanism to catalog APIs to display latest data quality indicators beside dataset metadata, ensuring governance visibility.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-004", "T-005"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-007",
      "title": "Create runbooks for top 20 failure scenarios",
      "description": "Document troubleshooting steps, remediation workflows, and escalation guidelines for common data quality issues in confluence or internal knowledge base.",
      "category": "Documentation",
      "estimated_hours": 4.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-005"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-008",
      "title": "Functional and performance testing of validation pipelines",
      "description": "Test data quality jobs for accuracy, coverage, and ensure runtime overhead is below 10% versus baseline pipeline execution times.",
      "category": "Testing",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001", "T-002", "T-005"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-009",
      "title": "Implement Airflow metrics and logging enhancements",
      "description": "Add structured logging for validation results, remediation actions, and alert triggers; configure monitoring dashboards for execution traces.",
      "category": "DevOps",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001", "T-005"]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "id": "R-001",
      "description": "Alert fatigue due to excessive notifications across 50+ critical tables.",
      "severity": "High",
      "mitigation": "Implement severity-based grouping and domain-level throttling in alerting system."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-002",
      "description": "Performance degradation if validation checks exceed 10% runtime overhead.",
      "severity": "High",
      "mitigation": "Optimize parallelism and apply caching strategies in Great Expectations validation tasks."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-003",
      "description": "Integration complexity with existing Databricks/Snowflake pipelines.",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Schedule validations in asynchronous Airflow tasks and leverage existing data connectors."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-004",
      "description": "Incomplete rule coverage across business domains during initial rollout.",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Prioritize top 10 critical tables per domain and expand coverage iteratively post-sprint."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-005",
      "description": "Insufficient documentation could slow remediation of detected issues.",
      "severity": "Low",
      "mitigation": "Develop detailed runbooks and escalation workflows as part of sprint deliverable."
    }
  ],
  "definition_of_done": [
    "Automated data profiling runs successfully on new data sources.",
    "YAML-based rule configurations executed by Great Expectations.",
    "Real-time alerts triggered and grouped correctly by severity and domain.",
    "Dashboard shows accurate domain-level data quality metrics.",
    "Self-healing workflows validated for at least two failure patterns.",
    "Quality metrics published in Atlan/DataHub catalogs.",
    "All tests pass and runtime overhead remains below 10%.",
    "Runbooks completed for 20 common data failure scenarios."
  ],
  "total_estimated_hours": 66.0
}

{
  "architecture_overview": "The data quality framework architecture consists of modular components integrated within the existing Databricks and Snowflake data platforms. Airflow orchestrates validation and profiling workflows using Great Expectations for data quality evaluation. The framework includes automated profiling triggers for new datasets, rule-driven validations using YAML configurations, real-time alerting modules integrated with Slack and PagerDuty, self-healing workflows for remediation, and quality score dashboards synchronized with governance catalogs (Atlan/DataHub). Results are logged into a central quality metrics store with APIs for reporting and catalog sync.",
  "technology_stack": ["Great Expectations", "Apache Airflow", "Databricks", "Snowflake", "Python", "Slack API", "PagerDuty API", "DataHub API", "Atlan API", "Docker", "Grafana"],
  "api_endpoints": [
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/api/data-sources/register",
      "description": "Register new data source and trigger automated profiling using Airflow and Great Expectations.",
      "request_body": "{ 'source_name': 'string', 'connection_params': 'object', 'owner': 'string' }",
      "response": "{ 'status': 'string', 'profiling_job_id': 'string', 'metrics': 'object' }"
    },
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/api/rules/{dataset_name}",
      "description": "Fetch YAML-based rules for a given dataset from the configuration store.",
      "request_body": "none",
      "response": "{ 'rules_yaml': 'string', 'metadata': { 'last_updated': 'timestamp', 'owner': 'string' } }"
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/api/alerts/send",
      "description": "Send grouped and severity-filtered alert notifications to Slack and PagerDuty.",
      "request_body": "{ 'severity': 'string', 'domain': 'string', 'message': 'string', 'affected_tables': ['string'] }",
      "response": "{ 'status': 'string', 'alert_id': 'string' }"
    },
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/api/quality-scores/{domain}",
      "description": "Retrieve domain-level data quality scores for dashboard visualization.",
      "request_body": "none",
      "response": "{ 'domain': 'string', 'scores': { 'completeness': 'float', 'accuracy': 'float', 'consistency': 'float', 'timeliness': 'float', 'uniqueness': 'float' }, 'trend': 'object' }"
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/api/remediation/trigger",
      "description": "Trigger self-healing workflow for common data issues.",
      "request_body": "{ 'issue_type': 'string', 'dataset': 'string', 'pattern_id': 'string' }",
      "response": "{ 'status': 'string', 'remediation_job_id': 'string', 'action_log': 'object' }"
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/api/catalog/update-quality-metrics",
      "description": "Push latest data quality metrics to Atlan/DataHub catalog for governance visibility.",
      "request_body": "{ 'dataset_id': 'string', 'metrics': 'object' }",
      "response": "{ 'status': 'string', 'catalog_sync_id': 'string' }"
    }
  ],
  "database_schema": "CREATE TABLE data_quality_metrics (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, dataset_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, domain VARCHAR(100), timestamp TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completeness FLOAT, accuracy FLOAT, consistency FLOAT, timeliness FLOAT, uniqueness FLOAT, severity_level VARCHAR(50), remediation_status VARCHAR(50)); CREATE TABLE data_source_registry (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, source_name VARCHAR(255), connection_params JSONB, owner VARCHAR(255), profiling_job_id VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP); CREATE TABLE quality_rule_configs (dataset_name VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, rules_yaml TEXT, last_updated TIMESTAMP, owner VARCHAR(255)); CREATE TABLE alert_logs (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, alert_id VARCHAR(255), severity VARCHAR(50), domain VARCHAR(100), affected_tables JSONB, message TEXT, triggered_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP); CREATE TABLE remediation_logs (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, remediation_job_id VARCHAR(255), issue_type VARCHAR(100), dataset VARCHAR(255), pattern_id VARCHAR(100), action_log JSONB, executed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);",
  "security_considerations": [
    "Authenticate all API endpoints using OAuth2 with role-based access control for data engineers and stewards.",
    "Encrypt all stored YAML files and metrics with AES-256 encryption at rest.",
    "Secure Slack and PagerDuty API tokens via AWS Secrets Manager.",
    "Implement audit logging for all rule changes and remediation executions.",
    "Apply fine-grained permission controls to restrict access to sensitive datasets.",
    "Ensure HTTPS connections and mutual TLS between Airflow workers and APIs.",
    "Limit the exposure of health and metrics endpoints using IP whitelisting."
  ],
  "code_structure": {
    "folders": {
      "airflow_dags": ["profiling_dag.py", "validation_dag.py", "alerting_dag.py", "remediation_dag.py"],
      "great_expectations": ["expectations/", "datasources/", "checkpoints/", "ge_config.yml"],
      "config_rules": ["rules/domain1/", "rules/domain2/"],
      "api_service": ["app.py", "routes/", "models/", "controllers/", "security/"],
      "dashboard": ["src/", "components/", "pages/", "services/"],
      "docs": ["runbooks/", "architecture/", "failure_scenarios/"]
    }
  },
  "implementation_notes": "Airflow orchestration will coordinate Great Expectations profiling and validation jobs. Use event-driven triggers for new data sources detected in Databricks/Snowflake. The YAML rule parser will dynamically inject validation configurations into Great Expectations checkpoints. Alerts will be sent via preconfigured integrations using webhook APIs for Slack and PagerDuty, with severity aggregation logic to prevent alert fatigue. Dashboards will be powered by Databricks SQL or Grafana querying the data_quality_metrics table. Self-healing workflows will be implemented as separate Airflow DAGs invoking remediation scripts based on detected patterns. Quality metrics sync to catalogs will use REST integrations to Atlan/DataHub. Logging and monitoring are enhanced with Airflow and Datadog plugins to ensure runtime overhead below the defined 10% threshold. All components will be containerized using Docker for consistent deployment across environments."
}

{
  "test_strategy": "Adopt a hybrid strategy combining unit, integration, and end-to-end testing using Pytest and Great Expectations validation frameworks. Leverage Airflow’s built-in test utilities for DAG validation. Employ mock APIs for Slack/PagerDuty/DataHub integrations. Use lightweight data sets on Snowflake/Databricks for validation and performance benchmarking. Ensure tests run in CI pipeline with coverage reports. Focus on functional correctness, alert accuracy, remediation reliability, and SLA adherence to keep overhead <10%.",
  "test_cases": [
    {
      "id": "TC-001",
      "title": "Automated data profiling triggers for new data source",
      "description": "Verify that registering a new data source automatically triggers Great Expectations profiling DAG and produces completeness/uniqueness metrics.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Airflow and Great Expectations configured", "Databricks/Snowflake connection available"],
      "steps": [
        "Call POST /api/data-sources/register with valid source_name and connection_params",
        "Verify Airflow DAG profiling_dag triggered",
        "Check that metrics in response contain completeness and uniqueness values"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Profiling job triggered successfully; response contains valid metrics with values between 0 and 1",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-002",
      "title": "YAML-based data quality rule execution",
      "description": "Validate Great Expectations runs according to YAML-configured rules.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Dataset has corresponding YAML rules predefined"],
      "steps": [
        "Run GET /api/rules/{dataset_name}",
        "Inspect returned YAML for rule format compliance",
        "Trigger Airflow validation DAG using these rules",
        "Verify validation result matches rule expectations"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Great Expectations validation executes without syntax errors; failed expectations accurately logged",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-003",
      "title": "Real-time alerting via Slack and PagerDuty",
      "description": "Confirm grouped alert notifications sent for critical validation failures.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["Slack webhook and PagerDuty API keys configured"],
      "steps": [
        "Simulate failed validation with severity=critical",
        "Call POST /api/alerts/send with payload containing domain and affected_tables",
        "Inspect Slack and PagerDuty logs for grouped message content"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Alert message appears in Slack and triggers PagerDuty incident with correct severity and grouping",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-004",
      "title": "Quality score dashboard visualization",
      "description": "Confirm dashboard displays domain-level metrics and trends correctly.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["Quality scores stored in data_quality_metrics table"],
      "steps": [
        "Invoke GET /api/quality-scores/{domain}",
        "Verify JSON contains completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness values",
        "Access UI dashboard and verify matching plotted values and trend data"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Dashboard displays accurate scores and trend alignment with backend API values",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-005",
      "title": "Self-healing workflow triggers remediation",
      "description": "Test that the remediation DAG executes automatically upon known issue detection.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Known failure pattern defined in remediation logic"],
      "steps": [
        "Simulate data issue event with type 'missing_partitions'",
        "Trigger /api/remediation/trigger API",
        "Verify remediation DAG executes successfully and logs correction details"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Remediation completes successfully with proper logging in remediation_logs table",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-006",
      "title": "Expose quality metrics in Atlan/DataHub catalogs",
      "description": "Ensure latest data quality metrics are visible in connected governance tools.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Catalog integration tokens configured"],
      "steps": [
        "Trigger /api/catalog/update-quality-metrics with dataset_id and metrics payload",
        "Query catalog API to confirm update",
        "Verify metrics displayed alongside dataset metadata"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Catalog entry reflects updated data quality metrics without latency ≥5 minutes",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-007",
      "title": "Performance overhead test of validation workflows",
      "description": "Validate that pipeline runtime overhead due to quality checks remains below 10%.",
      "test_type": "Performance",
      "preconditions": ["Baseline runtime recorded", "Profiling and validation configured"],
      "steps": [
        "Execute Airflow pipelines with and without quality checks",
        "Compare total runtime difference percentage",
        "Record results for multiple datasets (small, medium, large)"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Runtime overhead ≤10% across all tested pipelines",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-008",
      "title": "Security validation for API access and secrets management",
      "description": "Verify OAuth2 authentication and token encryption for services.",
      "test_type": "Security",
      "preconditions": ["OAuth2 configured in FastAPI app", "Secrets stored in AWS Secrets Manager"],
      "steps": [
        "Attempt unauthorized access to API endpoint",
        "Verify response is HTTP 401",
        "Inspect environment to confirm secrets not exposed as plain text"
      ],
      "expected_result": "All endpoints enforce authentication; secrets remain encrypted at rest",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-009",
      "title": "Negative test - invalid YAML rule file",
      "description": "Ensure system handles malformed YAML configuration gracefully.",
      "test_type": "Unit",
      "preconditions": ["Malformed YAML file exists in config_rules"],
      "steps": [
        "Call GET /api/rules/{invalid_dataset_name}",
        "Observe server error response",
        "Check logs for descriptive error and absence of system crash"
      ],
      "expected_result": "HTTP 500 or 404 error returned with descriptive message, system remains stable",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-010",
      "title": "Edge case - duplicate detection on unique keys",
      "description": "Validate data uniqueness checks correctly identify duplicates.",
      "test_type": "Unit",
      "preconditions": ["Dataset with intentional duplicate keys available"],
      "steps": [
        "Run Great Expectations uniqueness check on test dataset",
        "Observe validation output and recorded metrics"
      ],
      "expected_result": "Duplicates flagged accurately in metrics, severity logged as medium or higher",
      "priority": "Medium"
    }
  ],
  "test_data_requirements": [
    "Sample Databricks/Snowflake datasets with missing, duplicate, and erroneous records",
    "YAML rule files for each quality dimension",
    "Mock Slack and PagerDuty endpoints for alert testing",
    "Baseline execution time metrics for pipelines",
    "Synthetic trend history for dashboard visualization",
    "Invalid YAML files for negative testing"
  ],
  "automation_approach": "Use Pytest for API endpoint and unit validation; incorporate Great Expectations automated validations under CI using pytest-ge plugin. Airflow DAG unit testing via airflow-dag-test-utils. Integrate test execution in GitHub Actions with containerized test environments (Docker). Mock external services using responses/moto libraries. Maintain test data fixtures for each domain to enable quick regression runs.",
  "coverage_goals": "Achieve ≥85% code coverage across API, Airflow DAGs, and utility modules; ≥90% test coverage of critical user stories (profiling, rules, alerting, remediation). Include performance tests across 3 representative datasets (small/medium/large). Validate all key dimensions—completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness—and ensure governance sync and alert reliability at production standards."
}

{
  "summary": "The release establishes an enterprise-grade data quality framework integrating Great Expectations and Airflow with Databricks and Snowflake to proactively detect, alert, and remediate data issues. Automating profiling, configurable rules, dashboards, and real-time alerts will reduce the $500K annual cost of data errors, enhance trust across 200+ data consumers, and strengthen governance visibility and SLAs.",
  "scope_overview": "This release delivers the foundation of a scalable data quality framework covering five quality dimensions. Key deliverables include automated profiling for new datasets, YAML-based configurable validation rules, real-time alerting via Slack and PagerDuty, domain-level quality dashboards, self-healing workflows, and catalog-level visibility through Atlan/DataHub integrations.",
  "key_risks": [
    "Potential alert fatigue if notifications are not properly grouped or weighted.",
    "Performance overhead exceeding the 10% threshold impacting pipeline SLAs."
  ],
  "test_readiness": "Comprehensive test coverage achieved with Pytest and Great Expectations. All critical workflows—profiling, validation, alerting, and remediation—verified in functional, integration, and performance tests. Security and governance integrations validated; overall readiness to deploy to production is high.",
  "recommendations": [
    "Fine-tune alert severity grouping and domain-based throttling before scale-out to prevent alert fatigue.",
    "Implement ongoing performance monitoring to ensure checks remain within acceptable runtime overhead."
  ],
  "next_steps": [
    "Deploy framework to production for 50 critical tables and monitor KPI improvements over 3 months.",
    "Expand data quality rule coverage to 500+ tables and integrate dashboards with executive reporting."
  ]
}
